title: Heegaard Floer homology and maximal twisting numbers
summary: We adapt the Ozsváth-Szabó full path algorithm to every star-shaped graph and establish a correspondence between negative-twisting tight contact structures on any Seifert fibred space over $S^2$, and its Heegaard Floer homology groups equipped with the Alexander filtration induced by the regular fibre. This provides the complete classification of negative-twisting structures on these manifolds; in particular, we distinguish them by their contact invariant $c^+$.
